关键行为——基层管理者: 1. 工作中能够深入理解上级要求，立即转化为行动步骤并清晰地传达给下属。
firstline manager: 1.Deeply understand requirements from superiors, quickly translate them into actionable steps, and clearly communicate them to subordinates.

关键行为——基层管理者: 2. 依据部门年度规划，拆解团队重点任务，制定可落地的执行计划
firstline manager: 2.Break down key team tasks and develop executable implementation plans based on the department's annual planning.

关键行为——基层管理者: 3. 主动发现一线业务问题，提出可落地的改进举措或工作流程的改进建议
firstline manager: 3.Proactively identify frontline business issues, and propose actionable improvement measures or workflow improvement suggestions.

关键行为——基层管理者: 4. 善于运用企业内外的经验和方法带领团队进行工作的创新改进，并且能够启发促进他人的创新。
firstline manager: 4.Be skilled at leveraging internal and external experiences and methods to lead the team in driving innovative improvements, and be able to inspire and promote innovation in others.

要素: 全球视野-管理复杂情况
关键行为——基层管理者: 5. 能识别不同视角的价值差异，形成高效的跨部门沟通与协作方式
firstline manager: 5.Be able to recognize the value differences across diverse perspectives, and form efficient cross-departmental communication and collaboration methods.

要素: 全球视野-管理复杂情况
关键行为——基层管理者: 6. 有效链接身边资源，推进解决日常工作中的一线复杂问题
firstline manager: 6.Effectively connect available resources and drive the resolution of frontline complex issues in daily work.

关键行为——基层管理者: 7. 以响应内外部客户需求为首要任务，主动倾听并快速反馈一线服务诉求
firstline manager: 7.Prioritize responding to the needs of internal and external customers, actively listen to and provide timely feedback on frontline service requests.

关键行为——基层管理者: 8. 立足岗位职能，协助解决内外部客户的实际问题，确保工作成果让客户满意
firstline manager: 8.Based on role responsibilities, assist internal and external customers in solving practical problems, ensuring that work outcomes meet customer satisfaction.

关键行为——基层管理者: 9. 持续跟踪客户需求变化，维护稳定良好的协作与服务关系
firstline manager: 9.Continuously track changes in customer needs, and maintain stable and positive collaboration and service relationships.

要素: 数智变革-加强数字应用
关键行为——基层管理者: 10 主动学习与岗位相关的数字化工具 / AI 应用，尝试引入日常工作以提升效率
firstline manager: 10.Proactively learn about digital tools/AI applications relevant to the role, and try to introduce them into daily work to improve efficiency.

要素: 数智变革-加强数字应用
关键行为——基层管理者: 11. 积极参与公司及部门数字化项目，完成岗位相关的数字化工作
firstline manager: 11.Actively participate in digital projects of the company and department, and complete role-related digital tasks.

关键行为——基层管理者: 12. 为团队设定清晰的绩效目标，身先士卒，带领团队完成任务
firstline manager: 12.Set clear performance goals for the team, lead by example, and lead the team to accomplish tasks.

关键行为——基层管理者: 13. 营造积极的学习氛围，提供实践锻炼机会，支持成员技能提升
firstline manager: 13.Foster a positive learning atmosphere, provide practice opportunities, and support members in enhancing their skills.

关键行为——基层管理者: 14. 对团队成员表现给予及时反馈，表扬进步，针对不足提供具体改进建议
firstline manager: 14.Provide timely feedback on team members' performance, praise progress, and offer specific suggestions for improvement.

关键行为——基层管理者: 15. 主动识别并快速推进工作任务，不被动等待指令，确保基础工作落地
firstline manager: 15.Proactively identify and promptly drive work tasks without passively waiting for instructions, ensuring that foundational work is implemented.

关键行为——基层管理者: 16.  以结果为导向，合理规划时间与资源，跟进任务进度，高效达成工作目标
firstline manager: 16.Focus on results, reasonably plan time and resources, follow up on task progress, and efficiently achieve work objectives.

关键行为——基层管理者: 17. 深刻理解公司文化内涵，以身作则，在日常工作中积极践行并传递文化价值观
firstline manager: 17.Deeply understand the company's culture, lead by example, actively practice and demonstrate cultural values in daily work.

关键行为——基层管理者: 18. 关注团队成员体验，将日常工作与文化传播结合，在团队内营造良好的文化氛围
firstline manager: 18.Focus on team members' experience, integrate daily work with company's cultural dissemination, and create a positive cultural atmosphere within the team.

关键行为——基层管理者: 19、以坦诚精神、言出必行和公开透明的作风，建立与同事间的信赖和信任感，构建简单、互信、尊重、友爱的人际关系
firstline manager: 19.Establish trust and confidence with colleagues through a spirit of honesty, accountability and transparency. Build simple, trustworthy, respectful, and caring interpersonal relationships.

关键行为——基层管理者: 20、自觉维护团结，能够顾全大局，多帮助多补位
firstline manager: 20.Consciously maintain unity, take a broader perspective, and proactively support others where needed.

关键行为——基层管理者: 21、树立“合规”意识，带头践行合规文化，将合规理念贯穿于日常经营行动的每一个环节
firstline manager: 21.Establish a "compliance" mindset, take the lead in practicing a compliance culture, and integrate the concept of compliance into every aspect of daily business operations.

关键行为——基层管理者: 22、杜绝官僚主义作风，不拉帮结派，不搞权力斗争，不任人唯亲，不默认、纵容下属的任何迎合和奉承行为
firstline manager: 22.Reduce bureaucracy, foster fairness, avoid power politics, and maintain professional, respectful relationships.

关键行为——基层管理者: 23、树立道德高线，严守纪律底线
firstline manager: 23.Set high moral standards and strictly adhere to the bottom line of discipline.

关键行为——基层管理者: 1. 请列举2-3个您认为被评估人表现出色并值得他人学习的行为。
firstline manager: 1. Please list 2-3 areas where you believe the assessed individual has performed exceptionally well, and is worthy of being learned from by others.

关键行为——基层管理者: 2. 请指出2-3个您认为被评估人有可发展空间的方面，并提供具体的发展建议。
firstline manager: 2. Please identify 2-3 areas where you think the assessed individual has room for development, and provide specific suggestions for improvement.

关键行为——基层管理者: 3. 您对被评估人的其他建议？
firstline manager: 3. Do you have any other suggestions for the assessed individual?
